name: recovery-diff
title: Recovery Diff
description: A connection form where a failed check explains itself inline instead of just saying something went wrong: a real character-level diff, computed against whatever you actually typed, highlights exactly what differs field by field, and a one-click fix button applies that specific field's correct value rather than offering a generic retry. Fix one field and its diff panel collapses immediately; get every field right and an inline success line confirms it, no modal anywhere in the flow.
